chunks: Aban narrated from Isma'il ibn al-Fadl, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who undertakes the kharaj of the people, the jizyah on their heads, and the kharaj of palm trees, trees, reed-beds, hunting grounds, fish, and birds, while he does not know—perhaps this may never come to be, or it may come to be—whether he may buy it, and in which time he may buy it and undertake it from him.
So he عليه السلام said: If you know that one single thing from that has already ripened or become realized, then buy it and undertake it on that basis.

key_terms.أَدْرَكَ: has become realized, matured, or reached a valid stage of existence
key_terms.الْمَصَايِدِ: hunting grounds or places of capture as revenue-producing assets
key_terms.جِزْيَةَ: poll tax levied on persons under specified legal conditions
key_terms.خَرَاجَ: land-tax or revenue assessment taken from productive property or land
key_terms.وَتَقَبَّلْ: and undertake or accept responsibility for it
key_terms.يَتَقَبَّلُ: undertakes contractual responsibility for collecting or delivering revenue

ai.seo_question: When is it permissible to purchase or undertake kharaj and jizyah revenues if their yield is uncertain?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the purchase or undertaking of tax and revenue rights tied to uncertain yields and public assets. Imam Abu Abdillah عليه السلام permits the transaction when it is known that at least one part of the contracted assets has already become realized, establishing a basis of actual deliverable value.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3832 - Aban narrated from Ismail ibn al-Fadl, who reported from Abu Abdillah (as):

I asked him about a man who accepts responsibility for the payment of poll tax (jizyah) for individuals, the land tax (kharaj) for palm trees, crops, forests, hunting grounds, fish, and birds, while he does not know whether any of these will produce revenue or not. Can he purchase and accept responsibility for it, and at what time should he make such a purchase and agreement?
Imam (as) said: "If you know that at least one of these sources will yield income, then you may purchase and accept responsibility for it."
